name: Smoky Dijon Pink Salmon
text:
INGREDIENTS
About 1 lb pink salmon
¼ tsp liquid smoke
2 tsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp avocado oil
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp smoked paprika
Black pepper to taste
A light sprinkle of salt

METHOD
1. Heat oven to 400°F. Pat salmon dry and place skin-side down on a lined baking sheet.
2. Stir together the liquid smoke, Dijon, oil, garlic powder, smoked paprika, pepper, and salt.
3. Brush a thin coating over the flesh.
4. Bake, checking at 10–12 minutes. Thicker fillets need longer; cook until the center reaches 145°F. Avoid overcooking lean pink salmon.
5. Optional: broil briefly for more surface browning, watching closely.

NOTES
No citrus zest required. Smoky is David’s default for salmon. Liquid-smoke strength varies by brand; ¼ tsp is the starting amount for this batch.

NUTRITION
Salmon package label: 130 calories and 24 g protein per 4 oz uncooked. Coating nutrition has not been calculated. Use the actual salmon weight, excluding packaging, for logging.

Source: recipe developed in conversation, October 23, 2026.
